lines.label: sign-in
lines.said: Renting for two. [[slnc 300]] Enter your email to sign in.

lines.label: new-order
lines.said: Your order opens empty, so add the first person to it.

lines.label: item-catalogue
lines.said: Open a collection, and choose your own gear from inside it.

lines.label: pick-the-dates
lines.said: Pick your pickup day, then your return day. [[slnc 300]] We hold the gear for every day between.

lines.label: party-members
lines.said: Now invite the second person to the same order.

lines.label: member-two-added
lines.said: They are on the order too.

lines.label: second-catalogue
lines.said: Open a collection again, and choose their gear the same way.

lines.label: second-dates
lines.said: Their dates are picked on their own calendar, so the two of you can rent over different days.

lines.label: the-questions
lines.said: Now the questions, one set per person, so every pair of skis is fitted before you arrive. [[slnc 300]] Height, boot size, skill level, weight and age for you. [[slnc 300]] Then the same for your party member, on their own card below yours. [[slnc 300]] We set the bindings from these numbers, which is why we ask. [[slnc 300]] Agree to the terms for both of you, and save.

lines.label: checkout
lines.said: One payment covers the whole order, for everybody on it.

lines.label: back-to-dashboard
lines.said: Both rentals sit in your order history, ready for your next trip.
